Terminal

term is the MixOS terminal (app id dev.mixos.term): tabs, split panes, and a grid drawn on the GPU. It is an egui shell (see AGENTS.md §4.1) around two private crates:

  • crates/term-core: the engine. PTYs, the VT grid, tabs and panes, selection, mouse reporting, configuration, the native session and the term.* Bus verbs.
  • crates/term-render: the grid on the GPU. A glyph atlas and instanced cells drawn by an egui-wgpu paint callback per pane. The CPU raster in term-core is its test oracle.

The shell adds the window: the toolkit title bar and menus, the tab strip, pane borders on whole physical pixels, the keyboard and input method, the pointer (selection, mouse reporting, middle-click paste of the primary selection), the clipboard, and font zoom. Every action is a command on the toolkit registry, published on term.command.executed.

The source is apps/term.

Bus

The window registers term (or term-<pid> when another instance holds it) and answers:

  • the terminal's verbs, served by term-core (HELP lists them): term.session, term.tabs, term.tab.*, term.panes, term.pane.*, term.snapshot, term.scroll, term.type, term.props.watch;
  • the window's own: term.commands, term.execute, app.describe, and the toolkit drive verbs (term.ui.*, term.window, term.window.state).

term --headless serves the terminal's verbs with no window.

Configuration

The desktop profile's terminal.* settings, held by settingsd and edited in Prefs: font family, size and weight, padding, border width, history lines, scroll speed, cursor shape and blink, the focus ring, copy on select, and TERM. The window follows them as they change; Ctrl+plus and minus write terminal.font.size back 400 ms after the last zoom key. Ctrl+0 returns to the profile size without writing, except to correct a write already in flight. An unsaved zoom stays pending in memory until another zoom key or a successful settings read; a validation refusal discards it. Failures schedule no retry timers. History lines and TERM apply to tabs and panes opened afterwards. Without settingsd the defaults stand, and zoom stays the window's own. TERM_FONT_PX sets the size until settingsd answers, and TERM_SPIKE_FONT overrides the font file; term --print-config prints the startup values.

Keys

term --help lists them. Tabs: Ctrl+Shift+T/W, Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown. Panes: Ctrl+Shift+E/O split, Ctrl+Shift+X close, Ctrl+Shift+arrows, Tab/Shift+Tab or Ctrl+Tab between split panes. Clipboard: Ctrl+Shift+C/V, Shift+Insert. Font: Ctrl+plus/minus/0 and Ctrl+wheel. History: Shift+PageUp/PageDown/Home/End. Alt is Meta (ESC before the key; Alt+cursor keys send xterm's CSI 1;3 sequences). Right-hand modifier chords are the person's own on MixOS and are not bound.

Building and testing

On an authorised build worker at a pushed commit:

cargo test --locked -p term-core -p term-render -p term
cargo build --locked --profile release-fast -p term

tests/window.rs takes an offscreen snapshot of the window with two tabs and a split; regenerate it with UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 and look at it. The PTY tests need the Mix binary at /opt/mixos/bin/mix.
